title: German Apple Oat Porridge
description: A hearty German-inspired oat porridge with sautéed apples, perfect for a cold winter morning.

ingredients.name: apple
ingredients.notes: Granny Smith or other sweet-tart variety

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.notes: or milk for a creamier porridge

instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring the water to a boil.
Add the oats, cinnamon, and nutmeg. Reduce heat to medium and simmer for 5 minutes.
Core and dice the apple. In a separate pan, cook the apple over medium heat until tender.
Stir the cooked apple into the oat mixture.
Return the saucepan to low heat and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the porridge has reached your desired consistency.
Serve warm, topped with additional cinnamon or nutmeg if desired.
